default.description: Default desktop window capability (bundled launcher, local origin only).

workspace.description: Workspace windows served by the local Loom runtime.

workspace-ipc.description: App commands the loopback workspace web UI may invoke. Remote loopback origins only: `local: false` keeps these off the bundled launcher, and no non-loopback origin is listed. browser_operator_session additionally rejects any caller whose URL is not on the runtime origin the shell opened, under /ws/<workspace>.
